title: SPOKEN STEREOSET: ON EVALUATING SOCIAL BIAS TOWARD SPEAKER IN SPEECH LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice stereotype association tests measuring the model's preference for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical text continuations based on the gender (male or female) of the synthesized speaker's voice.

Multiple-choice stereotype association tests measuring the model's preference for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical text continuations based on the age (young, child, or elderly) of the synthesized speaker's voice.
